scripts.dcreset: docker compose down && docker compose up --build
scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production bun build ./src/server.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --minify && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs dist/pdf.worker.min.mjs
scripts.security:update: docker exec bun_backend_dev sh -c 'bun audit fix --latest && bun audit'
scripts.db:generate: docker exec bun_backend_dev bunx drizzle-kit generate --config=drizzle.config.ts
scripts.db:push: docker exec bun_backend_dev bunx drizzle-kit push --config=drizzle.config.ts
scripts.db:studio: docker exec bun_backend_dev bunx drizzle-kit studio --config=drizzle.config.ts --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.db:seed: docker exec bun_backend_dev bun run src/database/seed.ts
scripts.db-reset-and-seed: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
